title: Lovely Smoky Dutch Pork Skewers
description: A smoky and crispy Dutch dish featuring plum jam, perfect for a brunch mood, made with binchotan-charcoal for a unique flavor, and Whole30-friendly ingredients.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, using the binchotan-charcoal for a smoky flavor.
In a large bowl, whisk together the plum jam, coconut aminos, smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Add the pork cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated pork cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the pork is cooked through and slightly charred.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
